0022600109.text: The Spurs (0-2, 5th in the Southwest, 12th in the West) make their first road trip of the season as they visit the Mavericks (1-1, 3rd in the Southwest, 9th in the West), who enter on a one-game win streak. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb), Cooper Flagg (shoulder), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), and Kyrie Irving, Max Christie, Morez Johnson Jr., and Zaccharie Risacher are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Spurs won all four meetings in 2025-26 by a combined margin, most recently a 139-120 win over Dallas in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
